decisions.reason: The in-ear earmold costs little to keep alongside the firm's established custom hearing-care production, and with only thin evidence so far its option value is best preserved rather than abandoned.

The EARsleeve has its own page and draws on existing digital earmold manufacturing at low marginal cost, so keeping the option open while demand for universal in-ear systems develops is clearly justified.
The thermoforming unit is a core dental lab device with its own page and sunk certification investment, and no negative signal has appeared that would justify abandoning it.

The orthopedic shoe last is distant from the core business and therefore more uncertain, but it has its own page, was launched only recently and uses existing digital production know-how, so it is too early to judge and cheap enough to keep as an exploratory option.
The post-curing unit complements the firm's 3D-printing workflow and is cheap to keep, so its newly opened option should be held while early results come in.
